primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in HVPG at Week 96 and event-free survival (EFS).
efficacy_outcome: At Week 96, HVPG changed by −0.1 mmHg with SIM 200 mg, 0.0 mmHg with SIM 700 mg, and −0.1 mmHg with placebo. EFS comparisons had p-values of 0.41 and 0.065; group-specific EFS results were not reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events in the blinded phase affected 37/87 participants on SIM 200 mg, 36/86 on SIM 700 mg, and 25/85 on placebo; deaths were not reported.
